xna-type.name: FriendGamer
xna-type.summary: Provides the presence information of a friend of the local gamer.

property.name: FriendRequestReceivedFrom
property.summary: Gets whether the local gamer who requested the friends list has received a friend request from this gamer.
property.value: true if the local gamer who requested the friends list has received a friend request from this gamer; false otherwise.

property.name: FriendRequestSentTo
property.summary: Gets whether the local gamer who requested the friends list has sent a friend request to this gamer.
property.value: true if the local gamer who requested the friends list has sent a friend request to this gamer; false otherwise.

property.name: HasVoice
property.summary: Gets whether this friend currently has voice capability.
property.value: true if this friend currently has voice capability; false otherwise.

property.name: InviteAccepted
property.summary: Gets whether this friend has accepted an invitation from the local gamer who requested the friends list.
property.value: true if this friend has accepted an invitation from the local gamer who requested the friends list; false otherwise.

property.name: InviteReceivedFrom
property.summary: Gets whether the local gamer who requested the friends list has received an invitation from this friend.
property.value: true if the local gamer who requested the friends list has received an invitation from this friend; false otherwise.

property.name: InviteRejected
property.summary: Gets whether this friend has rejected an invitation from the local gamer who requested the friends list.
property.value: true if this friend has rejected an invitation from the local gamer who requested the friends list; false otherwise.

property.name: InviteSentTo
property.summary: Gets whether the local gamer who requested the friends list has sent an invitation to this friend.
property.value: true if the local gamer who requested the friends list has sent an invitation to this friend; false otherwise.

property.name: IsAway
property.summary: Gets whether this friend is currently away from the computer or console.
property.value: true if this friend is currently away from the computer or console; false otherwise.

property.name: IsBusy
property.summary: Gets whether this friend is currently busy.
property.value: true if this friend is currently busy; false otherwise.

property.name: IsJoinable
property.summary: Gets whether this friend is currently in a public session that can be joined.
property.value: true if this friend is currently in a public session that can be joined; false otherwise.

property.name: IsOnline
property.summary: Gets whether this friend is currently online.
property.value: true if this friend is currently online; false otherwise.

property.name: IsPlaying
property.summary: Gets whether this friend is currently playing a game.
property.value: true if this friend is currently playing a game; false otherwise.

property.name: Presence
property.summary: Gets a title-defined presence string describing what this friend is currently doing.
property.value: Title-defined presence string describing what this friend is currently doing.
